impact_assessment.why: User requested taking the fork's strobe feature; the core module is pure stdlib with 44 unit tests, safety-gated (no rate > refresh/2, lateness abort, explicit consent), and fills the product's visual stimulation gap
impact_assessment.benefits: Screen-tightening companion to audio beats with honest screen-capability reporting; reversible toggle in the bottom bar; calibration persisted in config visual section; tests raise suite to ~144
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ~560 fork wiring lines re-implemented against our diverged SourceCode (integration points: stop_audio, on_close, play_audio, apply_preset, main menu/bottom bar) -- kept additive, no signature changes; dependency: stdlib-only visual.py; concurrency: StrobeScheduler runs on Tk after() loop, no new threads -- import_config_json must reject hostile visual sections (merge_visual_config already coerces); state: visual settings persisted under config.visual -- sanitised by merge_visual_config on read
impact_assessment.mitigation: Port module+tests as one commit and run them standalone before any SourceCode change; wire in two sub-phases each under its own ui begin/verify/finish cycle; photosensitive warning dialog before first enable; fullscreen mode only via explicit button while audio plays; README updated same commit; visual review via PrintWindow captures of main window only (never capture active full-screen flashing)

Red-first tests proved in scratchpad before each implementation (begin needs a green tree).

impact_assessment.why: Audit of the 21 unpushed commits found a read-side validation gap and platform gaps in the freshly adopted strobe feature
impact_assessment.benefits: Corrupt/hostile config cannot distort strobe timing; Windows users get a real fallback refresh; users can withdraw consent once given; first launch shows guidance instead of an error state
impact_assessment.risks: contract: probe refactor changes probe_system_refresh_hz behavior per-OS - both branches keep None-on-failure semantics; dependency: ctypes/wintypes stdlib only, imported lazily inside the Windows branch; concurrency: none (menu handler, label update on Tk thread); state: consent revocation persists to config visual section via existing save_visual_setting
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure read-side change in visual.py with merge-level tests; SourceCode changes behind one ui cycle with pixel-diff review; revoke only touches one scalar and asks for confirmation first

[1/2] one-click launcher: bat (Windows) + sh (POSIX), venv bootstrap, dep install, GUI start; README section

impact_assessment.why: Installation needs 4 manual terminal steps today; PRINCIPLE-011 targets instant usability for a desktop app aimed at non-technical users
impact_assessment.benefits: double-click start on Windows and one command on macOS/Linux; isolated .venv avoids polluting system python; friendly Why/Fix errors when python is missing
impact_assessment.risks: venv creation fails on Debian without python3-venv; pip offline; pythonw hides startup errors; bat error text misleads users of very old python
impact_assessment.mitigation: Why/Fix messages name the exact remedy; pip failures point to the FAQ/issues; startup failure path keeps the console open with the direct terminal command; README documents the python3-venv requirement
